entries.title: Watcher No-progress Lane
entries.generationResetContract: NOPROGRESSRESET-01: changed watcher build or effective config resets scheduling debt at startup; preserve prior counters in the last ten generationHistory entries and cumulative generationResets; retain operator alert debounce; log and preserve old backoff on reset I/O faults
entries.incompleteWalkDecisionContract: Absorb current-head stored decline changes and charge the decision-reset cap without clearing scheduling debt; resource-limited observations leave no-progress counters and lastRunAt unchanged
entries.lastRunAtContract: Explicit null means no recorded walk; only absent legacy fields fall back to updatedAt
entries.drainDebtPolicy: preserve existing debt; expired hints resume normal accounting independently of closer
entries.ciWaitAdmissionContract: CIWAITLANE-01: a current-head nextAction wait-for-CI by actor ci keeps ordinary slow-lane backoff (it is not a hammer route); in plain slow-lane backoff one bounded candidate read may admit one walk when the wait's blocker cleared, and ciWaitAdmittedSignal records that signal so it cannot admit again on the same head
